payload.title: Edge writer: reference_links.py
payload.description:
New src/papyrus_content/reference_links.py, modelled on story_reporting.link_reference_to_story:
- link_references(client, a, b, predicate, provenance) for reference<->reference (related_to symmetric: one row, lower lineage id as subject; cites/supports/contradicts directional).
- link_concept(client, reference, node, provenance) = related_to reference -> semanticNode.
- id = reference-link-{predicate}-{hash(a,b)} (idempotent); relationState current|suggested|rejected with state keys via semantic_state_key(kind, lineage, state); score (cosine), confidence (calibrated P(accept) or null), classifierId (vector:text-embedding-3-small | rule:... | null), modelVersion.
- metadata {kind: reference.link | reference.concept, provenance: human|suggested|derived, suggestedBy, addedBy, addedAt, decidedBy, decidedAt, decision, reasonCode, note}.
- decide(client, relation_id, decision, reason_code, note, actor).
Unit tests: second write updates, never duplicates; a suggestion is not returned by any #current query; deciding records who and why.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
